name: Flohdom Horner Rennbahn
facts: running at the Horn racecourse since 2009, per the organiser
inside the racecourse grandstand building, and outside on the grass in fine weather
junk, knick-knacks, household goods and second-hand clothes; pitches for used and new goods
grounds of about 20,000 m², per the organiser
notes: Organiser lists Saturdays 3 Oct to 7 Nov 2026 (3 Oct included — only Bahrenfeld is cancelled that day); later dates derived from the stated 'jeden Samstag'. Sat 26 Dec dropped (public holiday), unconfirmed. Homepage says 06:00–15:00 twice, the booking page says 6 am–2 pm; recorded the homepage. Entry fee not stated. Address on the booking page: Rennbahnstraße 96 (homepage abbreviates 'Rennbahnstr.'); coordinates are the OSM house number 96 node on the racecourse grounds.

description.de: Jeden Samstag von 6 bis 15 Uhr auf dem Gelände der Horner Galopprennbahn, seit 2009. Gehandelt wird im Tribünengebäude und bei gutem Wetter auch draußen auf der Rasenfläche: Trödel, Nippes, Hausrat und Second-Hand-Kleidung, dazu etwas Neuware.
description.en: Every Saturday from 6 to 3 on the grounds of the Horn racecourse, since 2009. Trading happens inside the grandstand building and, in fine weather, out on the grass too: junk, knick-knacks, household goods and second-hand clothes, with some new goods.
